justifications.r1: 8x 1-drop mana dorks guaranteeing Turn 2 Henzie deployment and discounted blitz curves.
justifications.r2: Blitz provides automatic death card draw on every creature, augmented by Greater Good and Birthing Ritual.
justifications.a1: Survival of the Fittest and Birthing Ritual provide powerful creature tutoring.
justifications.a2: Blitz engine runs at full throttle starting Turn 3–4.
justifications.p1: Presents game-ending creature swarm and non-combat life drain on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps to close through combat, or 1 turn cycle with Living Death burst.
justifications.p3: Creature attack triggers are telegraphed but carry immediate haste and death draw value.
justifications.i1: Creature-based spot removal (Druid of Purification, Archon of Cruelty, Assassin's Trophy).
justifications.i2: Incidental sacrifice edicts (Archon of Cruelty, Massacre Wurm); no hard stax.
justifications.s1: Blitz creatures sacrifice themselves regardless of opponent interaction.
justifications.s2: Living Death and graveyard recursion turn board wipes into win conditions.
justifications.s3: Deck requires Henzie for blitz discounts, but can hardcast 5-drops in late game.
